verses.text: The LORD your God will bring you into the land you are going to take over. He will drive out many nations ahead of you: the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations bigger and stronger than you.
When the LORD your God hands them over to you and you defeat them, you must destroy them completely. Do not make any agreement with them, and do not show them mercy.
Do not marry any of them. Do not let your daughters marry their sons, and do not let your sons marry their daughters.
For they would turn your children away from following me to worship other gods. Then the LORD's anger would burn against you, and he would quickly destroy you.
This is what you must do to them: Tear down their altars, smash their holy stone pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
For you are a people set apart as holy to the LORD your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the LORD your God has chosen you to be his own special treasure.
The LORD did not love you and choose you because you were more in number than other peoples. In fact, you were the smallest of all peoples.

It was because the LORD loves you, and because he kept the promise he made to your ancestors. That is why he brought you out with his mighty hand and set you free from slavery, from the power of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
So know that the LORD your God is the true God. He is the faithful God who keeps his covenant of love for a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commands.
But he pays back those who hate him, to their face, by destroying them. He does not delay in paying back to their face those who hate him.
So be careful to obey the commands, rules, and laws I am giving you today.
If you listen to these laws and carefully obey them, the LORD your God will keep his covenant of faithful love with you, as he promised your ancestors.

He will love you, bless you, and make you grow in number. He will bless you with many children and with good crops: grain, new wine, and olive oil. He will bless your herds with calves and your flocks with lambs, in the land he promised your ancestors he would give you.
You will be blessed more than any other people. None of your men or women will be unable to have children, and none of your animals either.
The LORD will keep you free from all sickness. He will not bring on you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will put them on all who hate you.
You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God hands over to you. Do not feel sorry for them, and do not worship their gods, for that would be a trap for you.
You may say to yourselves, "These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?"
But do not be afraid of them. Remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all of Egypt.

You saw with your own eyes the great troubles, the miracles and wonders, and the mighty hand and powerful arm with which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you are afraid of now.
The LORD your God will also send panic among them, until even those who hide from you are destroyed.
Do not be terrified of them, for the LORD your God is with you. He is a great and awesome God.
The LORD your God will drive out those nations ahead of you little by little. You will not be allowed to destroy them all at once, or the wild animals would grow too many for you.
But the LORD your God will hand them over to you. He will throw them into great confusion until they are destroyed.
He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you. You will destroy them all.
Burn the idols of their gods in the fire. Do not want the silver or gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or it will be a trap for you. The LORD your God hates it.
Do not bring any of these hated things into your house, or you will be destroyed along with it. Hate it completely and turn away from it in disgust, because it is set apart to be destroyed.
